scenario: [LTSL.4.1] / [LGRA.9.8.3]: `json("…")` over one string literal is a test value, so a test can seed a `Json` slot, while the same call in a rule is refused (LGRA.9.8.3_json_refused). The `inputs` fact constructs `Doc` with `payload: json("{\"a\": {\"b\": 1}}")`, whose braces are literal text, not an interpolation site. PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.ltsl_4_1_literal`'s `json` arm and `json_literal_checked`, which lower the argument to `TestSlotLiteral.j_val` verbatim. What this does NOT pin: that the text reaches a runner, or that a runner refuses text that is not JSON; `compile_ok` stops at the artefact.
rules_ds:
schema Doc scope logical:
    id: Int key
    payload: Json mutable

rule seen:
    Doc
->
    log info "seen"

test "a Json slot seeded from a json() test value":
    inputs:
        at 0_s:
            Doc id: 1 payload: json("{\"a\": {\"b\": 1}}")
    produces:
        wm count Doc == 1
